book.name: PILIPI
book.title: Nyovara Wao Paulus Po Ratoe Anugano Amisye Mai No PILIPI

content: Ayao manasyin

Risyirati Paulus, umba Timotius tavondi tavon. Irimamo vatano irimanapatambe Yesus Kristus ai. Nyovara waowe so more irati Amisye apa kawasae wasai tenambe wana no munijo Pilipi, weapirati wabe intabove no Yesus Kristusa nui. Muno more tavon irati wapa akarijo wo wasaugave mansai muno wapa vatano wo anugano Amisye wasaeranande mansai tenambe.
Kove muno saumane no no wama Injayo Amisy muno Amisy Yesus Kristus no wasautan tenambe.
Paulus apa sambaya po kove raura seo Amisye ai
Risyo kove raura seo Amisy ai arono rui vayave syo weasatantona.
Syo sambaya rave wasai tenambe tutir, ribe sambayambe inanuga ranayanambe rautan.
Inanayanambe syo kove raura seo Amisy ai, weye arono manasyin ride wasai kobeyoe ndea unumeso wea tavon wapo Ayao Kovo Yesus ravovo rinatavon.
Amisye opirati po anakero ngkove rausiso no wasanuga rai arono manasyinoe, muno syanave Ai opamo po apa anakero no wasanuga rai umaso raijar tutira ntoa mewen no masyoto Yesus Kristus pakare rai.

Risyo weasatantona somamo mamaisy weye inanuga no wasai rave. Muno weapamo watavondi Amisye apa kovo po raunande rinai rai, weye wapo inaeranande arono syo Ayao Kove ravov, muno wapo inaeranande tavon arono syo ayaowe rasakinavo vatano wo Ayao Kove so raura tantunawije mansai, muno arono rimakova no tanoano makova so rai tavon.
Weye Amisye po raen risyamo inaemeno wasai rave, sya muinyo wasai maisyare Yesus Kristus taune muinyo wasai wemaisy.
Risya sambaya syo rave wasai mi so: syare indamu wapa muinye miridi nseo muno wapo Amisye aene miridi nseo tavon. Muno anakotaro rui nande wasai, syare Amisye po wasakarikuga raniku ramu mbar,
indamu wananta ana ngkove rai muno wabeta rai. Wirati wasanuga ngkakavimbe muno ayao kakai inta raen no wasai jewen arono masyoto Kristus pakare.
Muno ribe sambayambe indamu wapa ana wadave ti ngkove mamo manui rave, weye Yesus Kristus po vambunine raugaje wasai. Wirati vatane wo wasaen umba ukangkamambe Amisye ai muno wo ararimbe.
Paulus opamo makova, weramu Ayao Kovo Yesus makova ramu
Sya arakove, syare wapo raen: Siurijo nande rinai somamo ama ngkove no rai. Weye wemi mbewar Ayao Kovo Yesus maneka manakoe, weti vatane wanui wo raraniv.
Maisyare omai ti, naito nanawirati wo akarijo titi apa yavare raman muno vatano kaijo rui vayave una no naiso wo raen tenambe risyamo syanapatambe Kristus ai omi mbewar inausiso makova.
Muno risya inausiso makova so mbewar arakove wanui awa anave Amisye ai miridi nseo ti wo ayao Amisye raura vambunimbe yara ujanive ramu.
Weramu tugae, vatane inta nawirati wo ayao Kristus ravov weye uparijo rinai muno ware wo inakivan. Yara kaijinta nawamo wo ayao Kristus ravovo manuga ngkove rautan.

Vatano manuga ngkove umaso wo ayao Kristus ravov weye umuiny irati Amisye ai muno umuinyo rinai tavon. Weye wo raen risyamo Amisye po inatayao indamu syo Ayao Kove raura kakavimbe syare omamo ayao tugae ma.

Weramu vatane umawe onawamo manuga ngkove jewen yara ubeker usea tame rai. Weti wo ayao Kristus ravovo tugaive jewen, yara wo ravov indamu vatane wanui utavondi mai. Weye ubeker indamu risya siuri no tanoano makova so rai miridi nseo.
Weramu wo ravovo kai, weye ama ngkove inta no rai. Awa bekere ngkakai rako ngko ndako, ana mbe mobe mamo wo ayao Kristus ravovo vatane mai. Weti inananibe, muno indati inananibe so no tawan tutir.
Weye syo raen wapa sambaya wapo rave rinai mamo Amisye po raraniv, weti indati Yesus Kristus apa Anawayo Vambunine mo rinaeranande indamu syuje tanoano makova so raora.

Ana ribekero rai muno rinanave ramen dave mamo syare syo Kristus apa anakere so raijaro matuve, vemo ana inta mo inave samaneve nora. Weti ribeker indamu inanuga so mbambunin tutir arono naiso muno miridi nto, indamu ranivara wene nande rinai rako jewena rako, weamo Kristus aijaseo titive tutir no rinai.
Weye risyamo rino no mine vone somamo indamu ritavondi Kristus ai. Weramu kove mamo wene nande rinai indamu syoroto rituna Kristus atavon no munijo ntiti rai.

Maisyare wemai ti, rui mirati syare syo ratayao rinamarom dave, syantatukambe rai: riko da rino kai no mine so rati rako, ikakai vayave rako? Ana jirume so yo rinauwabe. Ribeke dave syo mine so ama rapaya indamu rituna Kristus atavon, weye wemirati ngko dave mije. Weramu ngko dave mamo riko da ino kai no mine so rati, indamu syo anakero Amisye po raugaje rinai ama ine raen dati.
Muno ngkovo wasai omamo rino tutiro wasarijat no mine so.
Wemi mbewar inanuga ntindimu anakotare so rai: Syo raen indati rino tawan tutiro wasarijat tenambe indamu wapa anave ntubai mbambunin dave, muno wasananibe miridi nseo weye wapanave Kristus ai.
Weti ranivara risyakaore wasai ti wapo inaen akato, indati wapo Yesus Kristus ararimbe miridi nseo.

Sya arakove, mbe mobe mamo wapa ana wadaveye ngko dave tenambe, mamaisyo Ayao Kovo Kristus mo wasanyao rai. Syare wapo raveare wemaisy indamu ranivara syakaore inande wasai jakatoa rako jewena rako, indati syo ranaun weapamo wabe intabove, muno wapa bekere intabo indamu wapo anakere raijaro panyoambe indamu vatano wanui wanave Ayao Kove rai.

Vemo wapo wapa marova wo wasave tatugadi masyaniv inya, yara syare wasanuga mbambunin. Ranivara wapo masyanive jewen, omamo mbe rarorombe mai wenanawamo indati Amisye po mangke raugaje mai, yara weapamo Po kovo nuge nuganuije raunande wasai.
Weye Amisye po wasatayao indamu wapanave Kristus ai, muno obo ma jewen, yara Po wasatayao indamu wasiuri weye wapanave Ai.
Soamo wasatawandi siurije rai maisyare muno rinamaisy. Wapo inaen risiuri no wusyinoe weye vatane wo inave tatugadi,
muno wapo ranaun risiuri namije soamo ta no rinai.

footnotes.text: Arono wusyinoe Paulus de po Ayao Kove ravov no munijo Pilipi, akarijo munije wato wo Paulus muno apa arakovo Silas yaugave isisa tanoano makova rai (Arakov 16:19-24).
